input: Get a full bloodwork panel done

gold.taskTitle: Get a Full Bloodwork Panel Done
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete a full blood work panel, likely involving scheduling, preparation, and follow-up with results.

questions.title: Do you have a primary care doctor to order this?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user has an existing doctor relationship or needs to find one.

questions.title: Is this a routine check-up or for a specific concern?
questions.description: Clarifying the medical purpose helps determine which panels are needed.

questions.title: Does your doctor need to order it or can you self-order?
questions.description: Some labs allow direct consumer ordering without a doctor's requisition.

questions.title: Do you have health insurance that covers lab work?
questions.description: Insurance status affects which lab to use and out-of-pocket costs.

questions.title: Have you already fasted or know fasting is required?
questions.description: Many blood panels require 8-12 hours of fasting before the draw.

questions.title: Which specific tests should be included in your panel?
questions.description: Knowing if they want CBC, metabolic panel, lipids, hormones, etc. shapes the plan.

questions.title: What is your deadline or urgency for getting this done?
questions.description: Understanding the timeline helps prioritize booking and follow-up steps.
